entries.title: Life is Dance, Dance is Death, Life is Dance with Death: The Art of Moriah Evans
entries.author: Momus Admin
entries.summary: The title for Moriah Evans’s newest dance is an unsayable sign: […/+*^%<>€£¥$&@!!!!^^^]. Perhaps some sort of experimental grawlix used in place of an unknown profanity, it sprouts shards of meaning when broken into parts: unfinishedness and ongoingness (“…”); mathematical operations (“/+*^%<>”); competing regimes of value, international exchange rates (“€£¥$”); connectors and conjunctions…

entries.title: Rural School in Oaxaca / Territorio Estudio
entries.author: Hadir Al Koshta
entries.summary: The project is based on a reflection on how educational spaces should be nowadays. From this starting point, we begin by creating shade - a roof supported by a flexible, light and open structure that allows for a dialogue between people, nature and architecture. The building adapts to the pre-existing conditions of the site and links the exterior and interior spaces by dissolving their boundaries.
